name: Note Mark AIO
description: Note Mark Aio is a self-hosted note taking app that allows you to create, organize, and share notes. It's a fork of the popular note-mark app with a focus on simplicity and ease of use.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Jwt secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-homarr application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-note-mark-aio
  # The `big-bear-note-mark-aio` service definition
  big-bear-note-mark-aio:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-note-mark-aio
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: ghcr.io/enchant97/note-mark-aio:0.19.4@sha256:b8d6ff400af1e3a27ef8f2968308310b9816ad35d066dc83aab9bbdf73a51069
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - JWT_SECRET=${SECRET_JWT_SECRET}
      - CORS_ORIGINS="http://example.com:8000"
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local /config directory to /config inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8000 of the host to port 8000 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8000"
    # Networks to be attached to the container
    networks:
      - big_bear_note_mark_aio_network
# Network definitions for the big-bear-note-mark-aio application
networks:
  big_bear_note_mark_aio_network:
    driver: bridge
